79e45850-e4fc-4829-929b-846a0eb0f8a0.note: 滷肉 batch: the recipe adds 2000 g 豬肥油 (backfat) to 2000 g 五花肉 but the stated yield is only 2800 g, which put the result at 924 kcal/100 g (nearly pure fat). The backfat renders into the braising liquid and is skimmed, not served. Assume about 1800 g of backfat-equivalent (88.7% fat, 812 kcal/100 g) never reaches the serve: result about 400 kcal/100 g, in line with 紅燒肉 (382). An estimate, not a measurement.
